title: NİŞANTAŞI KORU
description:
Nişantaşı Koru is an exclusive residential project in Istanbul's prestigious Nişantaşı district, developed by DAP Yapı. It combines luxury living with a focus on health and nature, offering a unique urban lifestyle.

Six blocks house a total of 160 residences, from 1+1 to 6+1. Each residence has an expansive terrace with an infinity pool and panoramic views of the Bosphorus, the surrounding grove and Nişantaşı. Ceiling heights range from 4 to 8 meters.

The project sits next to a 60,000 m² grove and the historic Ihlamur Pavilion, and close to Abdi İpekçi Street with its high-end boutiques. Amenities include private pools, a health studio, fitness center and entertainment facilities.

title: FOUR SEASONS PRIVATE RESIDENCE ETİLER
label: Hot Offer
description: The Four Seasons Private Residences Istanbul in Etiler is a premier luxury residential development that combines the renowned hospitality of the Four Seasons brand with sophisticated living. Developed in partnership with Tay Group, this project is situated at the convergence of the Ulus, Etiler, and Levent neighborhoods, offering residents proximity to upscale shopping, fine dining, and vibrant entertainment options. The development comprises 82 homes, including penthouses, a sky loft, garden suites, and apartment residences. Each unit features a modern yet classic design by interior designer Sinan Kafadar, emphasizing natural light and open living spaces. Select penthouses boast seven-meter-high ceilings with floor-to-ceiling windows, while the sky loft offers a private terrace and glass ceilings. Garden suites provide options for single-floor or duplex living with private green spaces. Residents have access to a range of exclusive amenities, including an indoor swimming pool, private cinema, fitness and wellness facilities, yoga and Pilates rooms, and a golf simulator suite. Additional services encompass housekeeping, private chef services, pet care, and 24-hour concierge and security. Etiler is one of Istanbul's most prestigious neighborhoods, known for its upscale cafes, restaurants, and shopping centers like Akmerkez. The area offers convenient access to major business districts and is well-connected to public transportation networks. The Four Seasons Private Residences Istanbul is scheduled for completion in 2024, promising a blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience in one of the city's most sought-after locations.

title: DAP YENİ LEVENT
description: The DAP Yeni Levent project is a premium residential development located in the Sarıyer district on the European side of Istanbul. Developed by DAP Yapı in collaboration with Emlak Konut, it aims to offer a harmonious blend of urban living and natural surroundings. Project Overview: Location: Sarıyer, Istanbul. Total Area: Approximately 103,000 m², with 85% dedicated to green spaces. Buildings: 16 low-rise blocks, each ranging from 8 to 10 floors. Residential Units: Various configurations from 1+1 to 4+1, including duplexes and penthouses. Commercial Units: 48 shops to cater to residents' needs. Key Features: Natural Integration: The project emphasizes a "country life in the city" concept, with extensive green areas and proximity to Belgrade Forest, providing a serene environment within the urban setting. Amenities: Residents will have access to outdoor and indoor swimming pools, fitness centers, Turkish baths, saunas, jacuzzis, massage rooms, cafes, and 24/7 security services. Smart Living: Equipped with smart home systems, private gardens, and terraces or balconies for each unit, promoting a healthy and comfortable lifestyle. Accessibility: Strategically located near major transportation hubs, including the Seyrantepe Metro Station, and close to prominent shopping centers like Kanyon, Istinye Park, and Vadi Istanbul. Investment Potential: Situated in one of Istanbul's most prestigious districts, DAP Yeni Levent offers a compelling opportunity for both investors and those seeking a high-quality living environment. The combination of modern amenities, natural surroundings, and strategic location enhances its appeal.

title: LOTUS ŞİŞLİ
description: In the heart of Istanbul, where innovation and luxury meet, 'Lotus Şişli' is a candidate to become one of the prestigious addresses of the region. title: ETRO RESIDENCE RAMS BEYOND
label: Featured
description: The Etro Residences at Rams Beyond is a prestigious luxury residential project located in Maslak, Istanbul, developed by Rams Global in collaboration with the renowned Italian fashion house, ETRO. This development marks ETRO's first venture into residential real estate, bringing their signature elegance and timeless design to the interiors of the residences.
